steps.en: Clone the repo and build it from source (there is no npm package yet)
steps.zh: 克隆仓库并从源码构建（还没有 npm 包）

steps.en: Point the CLI at your Claude Code config directory
steps.zh: 把 CLI 指向你的 Claude Code 配置目录

steps.en: Collects skills, agents, settings, MCP configs, rule files and archive paths
steps.zh: 收集 skill、agent、设置、MCP 配置、规则文件和压缩包路径

steps.en: Matches each file against six pattern modules, then checks one cross-file chain
steps.zh: 逐个文件比对六组模式，再查一条跨文件组合链

steps.en: Prints findings by severity with file:line and a fix; exits nonzero at high or above
steps.zh: 按严重度列出命中的文件行号和修法，达到 high 就以非零码退出

value.en: One offline pass shows which config files to open first, instead of grepping each by hand
value.zh: 离线跑一遍就知道先打开哪几个配置文件，不用逐个手工 grep

sources: https://github.com/tarang-tj/claude-skill-audit README 'One command' (git clone; npm install; npm run build; node dist/cli.js ~/.claude)
src/loaders.ts loadConfig (SKILL.md, agents/*.md, settings.json, settings.local.json, .mcp.json, .claude.json, CLAUDE.md, rules/*.md, binary paths)
src/rules/index.ts RULE_MODULES (seven modules: six per-file pattern modules plus escalationRules)
src/cli.ts (--fail-on default high, exit code 1) and src/report.ts renderText (severity groups, artifact:line, fix)
